item.title: Outside 71a Falkland Rd - in Montpelier Grove, 8th August
item.description:
Dear Tree People I am concerned abut the prunus autumnalis tree planted just outside 71a Falkland Road - actually physically in Montpelier Grove, marked below in yellow below. This is really suffering from drought as are so many trees in London, but the base of this tree had some rubbish cement dumped there by builders a few years ago. I have been putting a daily bucket of water down the water pipe of the tree just next door to it, but can’t water this bigger tree as the base needs loosening to absorb liquid. If someone could release the earth sufficiently or put one of those watering pipes down, I am happy to try and help the tree. Or am I wasting my time? Do these trees need far more than a daily bucket? Please advise. It is so tragic to see them wither. Please answer. Thanks.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 71, Falkland Road, Kentish Town, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet

item.title: Wrong sign on Road surfaceTheAvenue, 8th August
item.description:
The Avenue has one lane leading to Beechway. (On the left from The Drive entry. )The other lane takes traffic from the Avenue to the The Drive.It is on the right when you are in the Drive.In the middle of these lanes is a pedestrian walk way lined with trees.There is a triangle painted on the road surface of the lane leading to the Drive at the end of that lane. It implies you can use either lane to go to Beechway.A lorry fully parked in the left hand lane and caused traffic to go UP the wrong lane with the triangle on it.My neighbour was leaving her driveway in her car and was nearly hit by an oncoming car in the wrong lane Can a No Entry instruction be written on the road surface at the end of the Avenue to The Drive Road todrivers in the Drive turning right too early to go to Beechway and thus prevent a possible future accident?
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 98, The Drive, Blendon, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet
